units.sourceHTML: 7.16 Printing the First Lines

units.text: This script is probably the simplest useful ⟦0⟧ script. It displays the first 10 lines of input; the number of displayed lines is right before the ⟦1⟧ command.
units.sourceHTML: This script is probably the simplest useful sed script. It displays the first 10 lines of input; the number of displayed lines is right before the q command.

nonProse: Command/flag literals and pure code/output examples retained; explanatory dt labels and italic pre descriptions extracted too; no unhandled prose text.
